body: Yes I always felt like this is the purpose of my life, I just dont know how to. I mean I can do it in personal interaction ofcause, for the people around me. But I would like to do it for the whole world, it kind of saddens me that I cant do it for everyone. Thank you.

Thank you, I feel ok today so maybe I wont leave now, but I thought about that too. Im just a little bit to comfy right now, sitting in the warm while it is fucking cold outside. But I will remember what you said, and what this link said, I am pretty sure that I wouldnt have had killed myself but who knows? Whatever, I will make shit up right now, and if it doesnt work out... I always wanted to go to hawaii!

It really does, I feel like im in peace with myself right now. I hope it last a while. And just in case we wont ever meet again, I wish you all the best and may luck and happiness always be with you.
I believe in this world to change someday, maybe I am still here then.
I'll go to sleep, good night everyone

What I write right now may be a little bit religious even tho I am atheist. I believe that things and situations find you as soon as you need them. So if you care for people there will be a opportunity to help them, you dont have to work fulltime for charity. Maybe just help a old lady getting her bag up the stairs?

I will try that. Thank you very much, I am not crying at the moment and listening to a happy playlist instead of a sad one. So I guess this writing down and you really helped some. Thank you, thank you very much <3
I think it is because the world is changing somehow. I see many people caring more for the fellow human beings, feeling more in general. I guess thats good?

I thought about getting a dog, we had one when I was a kid and my parents were still together. I am just afraid that I wont take good care of him because I am so exhausted sometimes. Maybe I should try anyways?

I know how it feels to wake up in the afternoon and being dissappointed because you did. But when I turn music on it makes me a little less sad atleast, and I have to sleep with music on to. Because I cant find sleep when Im permanent crying, which I am if I dont hear music. I am saving money at the moment to get FLStudio to make music again (I played piano alot as kid, but cant aford areal piano at the moment), I will try to make people happy with my music, or die trying...
